summary: Curriculum Associates opposes tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes and supports maintaining E-Rate as a connectivity program for schools and libraries. The comment opposes the sunset of the E-Rate program and supports maintaining access to effective instructional technology for children. It cites the use of the i-Ready program by Curriculum Associates in providing curriculum and assessment support to school districts. The comment highlights the importance of the E-Rate program in providing broadband connectivity for schools to implement digital learning resources. The text discusses the importance of broadband infrastructure for educational purposes, including the use of digital materials for instruction and assessment. It highlights the potential impact of changes to E-Rate on maintaining stable broadband connections for educational activities. Brief The comment supports tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes based on empirical evidence showing the effectiveness of digital learning tools like i-Ready in improving student achievement. The comment supports tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes based on research showing implementation conditions drive results, not just minutes.
